copy.headline: Leopard lounge set with red ribbon ties — rest, refined.
copy.description: The Leonie refuses to look like loungewear: a cropped leopard tee edged in contrast red rib at the neck and cuffs, over high-waist capri leggings finished with red ribbon ties at the ankle. Soft stretch jersey for slow mornings and sunset terraces.
copy.atelierNotes: Ready-to-wear piece produced in limited runs. Ankle ties are hand-threaded grosgrain ribbon.
copy.editorialQuote: Leopard at rest — the house print, softened.

fabric.material: Leopard-print stretch jersey with red ribbon trims
fabric.drapeDescription: Soft stretch drape with a gently gathered tee hem
fabric.finish: Matte print with contrast red rib trims and grosgrain ankle ties
fabric.careInstructions: Machine wash cold. Dry flat. Do not tumble dry.
